source.text: בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֔וּא נָדְדָ֖ה שְׁנַ֣ת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְהָבִ֞יא אֶת־סֵ֤פֶר הַזִּכְרֹנוֹת֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַיָּמִ֔ים וַיִּהְי֥וּ נִקְרָאִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: In the night the that fled [the] sleep of the king, and he said to bring the book of the records, [the] matters of the days, and they were being read before the king.

en.L: In that night the sleep of the king fled, and he said to bring the book of the records, the chronicles, and they were being read before the king.
en.B: That night the king could not sleep. So he ordered the book of records, the chronicles, to be brought, and they were read aloud to the king.
en.R: That night the king could not sleep. So he gave orders to bring the book that recorded the events of his reign, and it was read aloud to him.

es.L: Aquella noche huyó el sueño del rey, y dijo que trajeran el libro de las memorias, las crónicas, y fueron leídas delante del rey.
es.B: Aquella noche el rey no podía dormir. Entonces mandó que le trajeran el libro de las memorias, las crónicas, y se las leyeron en voz alta.
es.R: Aquella noche el rey no podía dormir. Así que mandó traer el libro donde estaban escritos los sucesos de su reinado, y se lo leyeron en voz alta.

fr.L: Cette nuit-là, le sommeil du roi s’enfuit, et il dit d’apporter le livre des mémoires, les chroniques, et on les lut devant le roi.
fr.B: Cette nuit-là, le roi ne put pas dormir. Il ordonna donc qu’on apporte le livre des mémoires, les chroniques, et on en fit la lecture devant le roi.
fr.R: Cette nuit-là, le roi n’arrivait pas à dormir. Il a donc demandé qu’on apporte le livre où étaient écrits les événements de son règne, et on le lui a lu à haute voix.

sw.L: Usiku ule usingizi wa mfalme ukakimbia, akasema kiletwe kitabu cha kumbukumbu, mambo ya siku, navyo vikasomwa mbele ya mfalme.
sw.B: Usiku ule mfalme hakuweza kulala. Kwa hiyo akaagiza kiletwe kitabu cha kumbukumbu, yaani taarifa za matukio, nazo zikasomwa mbele ya mfalme.
sw.R: Usiku ule mfalme hakupata usingizi. Kwa hiyo akaagiza kiletwe kitabu kilichoandikwa matukio ya utawala wake, nacho kikasomwa kwa sauti mbele yake.

vi.L: Đêm ấy giấc ngủ của vua bỏ đi, và vua bảo đem sách ký lục, tức sử biên niên, đến, và người ta đọc trước mặt vua.
vi.B: Đêm ấy vua không ngủ được. Vua truyền đem sách ký lục, tức sử biên niên, đến, và người ta đọc lớn tiếng cho vua nghe.
vi.R: Đêm ấy vua không sao ngủ được. Vua ra lệnh đem cuốn sách ghi chép các việc xảy ra trong triều đại mình đến, và người ta đọc lớn cho vua nghe.

ko.L: 그날 밤에 왕의 잠이 달아났다. 그래서 왕이 기록의 책, 곧 그날그날의 일들을 가져오라고 말했고, 그것들이 왕 앞에서 읽혔다.
ko.B: 그날 밤 왕은 잠을 이룰 수 없었다. 그래서 왕은 기록의 책, 곧 궁중 일지를 가져오게 하여 자기 앞에서 소리 내어 읽게 했다.
ko.R: 그날 밤 왕은 잠이 오지 않았다. 그래서 자기가 다스리는 동안 일어난 일들을 기록한 책을 가져오게 하여 소리 내어 읽게 했다.

decisions.choice: the king's sleep fled: the king could not sleep
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pictures sleep running away from the king. It means he lay awake (compare Genesis 31:40, where sleep "fled" from Jacob's eyes).

decisions.choice: the book of the records, the chronicles: the official record of the reign
decisions.reason: Literally "the book of the remembrances, the matters of the days". It is the royal chronicle in which Mordecai's report of the plot against the king was written down (2:23); the same kind of book is named again in 10:2. Keeping such records was part of Persian court life (Ezra 4:15; 6:1-2).

decisions.choice: that night: the night after Haman built the gallows for Mordecai
decisions.reason: The chapter opens on the same night that Haman, on his wife's advice, had the gallows made and planned to ask for Mordecai's death in the morning (5:14). The story sets the king's sleepless night beside Haman's plan without saying why it happened.

decisions.choice: they were being read: the reading went on for some time
decisions.reason: The verb with a participle describes ongoing action: the records were read, one after another, until the passage about Mordecai came up (verse 2).

decisions.choice: the king could not sleep
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the plain sense of the picture; Literal keeps "sleep fled".

decisions.choice: the book that recorded the events of his reign
decisions.reason: Readable explains what "the chronicles" were.

decisions.choice: passé simple « s'enfuit », « ordonna » (Literal, Balanced); passé composé « a demandé », « a lu » (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in all the narrative of these books: the written narrative tense at Literal and Balanced, the spoken past at Readable.

decisions.choice: 그날그날의 일들 (L); 궁중 일지 (B)
decisions.reason: Literal gives 'the matters of the days' word for word; Balanced names the kind of book, a court journal, as meaning decision m2 explains.

source.text: וַיִּמָּצֵ֣א כָת֗וּב אֲשֶׁר֩ הִגִּ֨יד מָרְדֳּכַ֜י עַל־בִּגְתָ֣נָא וָתֶ֗רֶשׁ שְׁנֵי֙ סָרִיסֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ מִשֹּׁמְרֵ֖י הַסַּ֑ף אֲשֶׁ֤ר בִּקְשׁוּ֙ לִשְׁלֹ֣חַ יָ֔ד בַּמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was found written that had told Mordecai about Bigthana and Teresh, two of [the] eunuchs of the king, from [the] keepers of the threshold, who had sought to send a hand against the king Ahasuerus.

en.L: And it was found written that Mordecai had told about Bigthana and Teresh, two of the eunuchs of the king, from the keepers of the threshold, who had sought to lay a hand on King Ahasuerus.
en.B: There it was found written that Mordecai had exposed Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's eunuchs who guarded the doorway, who had plotted to assassinate King Ahasuerus.
en.R: The record said that Mordecai had reported two of the king's palace officials, Bigthana and Teresh, who guarded the door. They had planned to kill King Ahasuerus.

es.L: Y se halló escrito que Mardoqueo había denunciado a Bigtana y a Teres, dos de los eunucos del rey, de los guardianes del umbral, que habían procurado echar mano sobre el rey Asuero.
es.B: Allí se halló escrito que Mardoqueo había denunciado a Bigtana y a Teres, dos eunucos del rey que custodiaban la entrada, los cuales habían tramado asesinar al rey Asuero.
es.R: Allí estaba escrito que Mardoqueo había denunciado a dos funcionarios del palacio, Bigtana y Teres, que vigilaban la puerta. Ellos habían planeado matar al rey Asuero.

fr.L: Et on trouva écrit que Mardochée avait dénoncé Bigthâna et Téresh, deux des eunuques du roi, d’entre les gardiens du seuil, qui avaient cherché à porter la main sur le roi Assuérus.
fr.B: On y trouva écrit que Mardochée avait dénoncé Bigthâna et Téresh, deux eunuques du roi qui gardaient l’entrée, et qui avaient comploté d’assassiner le roi Assuérus.
fr.R: Le livre disait que Mardochée avait dénoncé deux officiers du palais, Bigthâna et Téresh, qui gardaient la porte. Ils avaient voulu tuer le roi Assuérus.

sw.L: Ikaonekana imeandikwa kwamba Mordekai alikuwa ametoa habari juu ya Bigthana na Tereshi, matowashi wawili wa mfalme, wa walinzi wa kizingiti, waliotaka kunyosha mkono juu ya mfalme Ahasuero.
sw.B: Ikaonekana imeandikwa humo kwamba Mordekai alikuwa amewafichua Bigthana na Tereshi, matowashi wawili wa mfalme waliolinda mlango, waliokuwa wamepanga njama ya kumuua mfalme Ahasuero.
sw.R: Kumbukumbu hizo zilisema kwamba Mordekai alikuwa amewaripoti maafisa wawili wa ikulu, Bigthana na Tereshi, waliolinda mlango. Hao walikuwa wamepanga kumuua mfalme Ahasuero.

vi.L: Và người ta thấy có chép rằng Mạc-đô-chê đã tố giác Bích-tha-na và Thê-rết, hai hoạn quan của vua, trong số những người giữ ngưỡng cửa, là những kẻ đã tìm cách tra tay hại vua A-suê-ru.
vi.B: Trong đó có chép rằng Mạc-đô-chê đã tố giác Bích-tha-na và Thê-rết, hai hoạn quan của vua canh giữ cửa, là những kẻ đã âm mưu ám sát vua A-suê-ru.
vi.R: Sách ghi rằng Mạc-đô-chê đã báo cho vua biết về hai quan chức trong cung là Bích-tha-na và Thê-rết, những người canh cửa. Hai người ấy đã lập mưu giết vua A-suê-ru.

ko.L: 그리고 모르드개가 빅다나와 데레스에 대하여 고한 것이 기록되어 있는 것이 발견되었다. 그들은 문지방을 지키는 자들 가운데 왕의 내시 둘로서, 아하수에로 왕에게 손을 대려고 꾀한 자들이었다.
ko.B: 거기에는 모르드개가 빅다나와 데레스의 일을 알렸다고 기록되어 있었다. 그들은 문을 지키던 왕의 내시 두 사람으로, 아하수에로 왕을 암살하려고 꾀했던 자들이었다.
ko.R: 그 기록에는 모르드개가 궁중 관리 두 사람, 곧 문을 지키던 빅다나와 데레스의 일을 알렸다고 적혀 있었다. 그 두 사람은 아하수에로 왕을 죽이려고 했었다.

decisions.choice: the plot told in 2:21-23
decisions.reason: This is the plot Mordecai uncovered while sitting at the king's gate. He told Esther, she told the king in Mordecai's name, the two men were hanged, and the matter was written in the chronicles (2:21-23). The first name is spelled Bigthan there and Bigthana here; both spellings are in the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: keepers of the threshold: guards of the doors to the king's private rooms
decisions.reason: The title names officials who controlled the entrance to the king's quarters, which gave them close access to him and made the plot dangerous (2:21).

decisions.choice: sought to send a hand against: plotted to kill
decisions.reason: To "send a hand against" someone means to attack or kill him (1 Samuel 24:7; 26:9). Here it is a plot to assassinate the king.

decisions.choice: palace officials
decisions.reason: As throughout Esther, Readable says "palace officials" where Literal and Balanced say "eunuchs" (see 1:10).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ מַֽה־נַּעֲשָׂ֞ה יְקָ֧ר וּגְדוּלָּ֛ה לְמָרְדֳּכַ֖י עַל־זֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ נַעֲרֵ֤י הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ מְשָׁ֣רְתָ֔יו לֹא־נַעֲשָׂ֥ה עִמּ֖וֹ דָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the king, What has been done [of] honor and greatness for Mordecai for this? And said [the] young men of the king, his attendants, Not has been done with him anything.

en.L: And the king said, "What honor and greatness has been done for Mordecai for this?" And the young men of the king, his attendants, said, "Nothing has been done for him."
en.B: The king asked, "What honor or high rank has been given to Mordecai for this?" The young men who attended the king answered, "Nothing has been done for him."
en.R: The king asked, "What has been done to honor and reward Mordecai for this?" His servants answered, "Nothing at all has been done for him."

es.L: Y dijo el rey: «¿Qué honra y grandeza se ha hecho a Mardoqueo por esto?». Y dijeron los jóvenes del rey, sus servidores: «No se ha hecho nada con él».
es.B: El rey preguntó: «¿Qué honor o qué alto rango se le ha dado a Mardoqueo por esto?». Los jóvenes que servían al rey respondieron: «No se ha hecho nada por él».
es.R: El rey preguntó: «¿Qué se ha hecho para honrar y premiar a Mardoqueo por esto?». Sus servidores respondieron: «No se ha hecho nada por él».

fr.L: Et le roi dit : « Quel honneur et quelle grandeur a-t-on accordés à Mardochée pour cela ? » Et les jeunes gens du roi, ceux qui le servaient, dirent : « On n’a rien fait pour lui. »
fr.B: Le roi demanda : « Quel honneur, quel haut rang a-t-on accordé à Mardochée pour cela ? » Les jeunes gens qui servaient le roi répondirent : « On n’a rien fait pour lui. »
fr.R: Le roi a demandé : « Qu’a-t-on fait pour honorer et récompenser Mardochée pour cela ? » Ses serviteurs ont répondu : « On n’a rien fait du tout pour lui. »

sw.L: Mfalme akasema, "Ni heshima gani na ukuu gani umefanyiwa Mordekai kwa ajili ya jambo hili?" Vijana wa mfalme waliomtumikia wakasema, "Hakufanyiwa neno lolote."
sw.B: Mfalme akauliza, "Mordekai amepewa heshima gani au cheo gani kwa ajili ya jambo hili?" Vijana waliomhudumia mfalme wakajibu, "Hakuna alichofanyiwa."
sw.R: Mfalme akauliza, "Ni nini kimefanyika ili kumheshimu na kumtuza Mordekai kwa jambo hili?" Watumishi wake wakajibu, "Hakuna kitu chochote alichofanyiwa."

vi.L: Vua nói: "Đã làm sự tôn trọng và sự vinh hiển gì cho Mạc-đô-chê vì việc này?" Các thanh niên của vua, là những người hầu hạ vua, thưa: "Chẳng có làm gì cho ông ấy cả."
vi.B: Vua hỏi: "Mạc-đô-chê đã được ban vinh dự hay chức tước gì vì việc này?" Các thanh niên hầu cận vua tâu: "Ông ấy chưa được ban gì cả."
vi.R: Vua hỏi: "Mạc-đô-chê đã được tôn vinh và ban thưởng gì vì việc này chưa?" Các đầy tớ thưa: "Chưa có gì cả."

ko.L: 그러자 왕이 말했다. "이 일로 모르드개에게 무슨 존귀와 높임이 베풀어졌느냐?" 그러자 왕을 섬기는 왕의 젊은 신하들이 말했다. "그에게 아무것도 베풀어진 것이 없습니다."
ko.B: 왕이 물었다. "이 일로 모르드개에게 무슨 존귀와 높은 지위를 주었느냐?" 왕을 시중드는 젊은 신하들이 대답했다. "그에게 아무것도 해 준 것이 없습니다."
ko.R: 왕이 물었다. "이 일로 모르드개를 높이고 상을 주려고 무엇을 했느냐?" 신하들이 대답했다. "아무것도 해 주지 않았습니다."

decisions.choice: honor and greatness: public honor and a rise in rank
decisions.reason: The two words are paired for a reward that brings both public esteem and higher standing. "Greatness" is used again of Mordecai's rank at the end of the book (10:2).

decisions.choice: a deed for the king was expected to be rewarded
decisions.reason: The king assumes that one who saved his life would have been rewarded. It is well attested that Persian kings recorded and rewarded those who did them service, and the question shows that in Mordecai's case this had been overlooked (2:23 says only that the matter was written down).

decisions.choice: the young men of the king, his attendants: the personal servants on duty with him
decisions.reason: The "young men" who "serve" the king are his personal attendants, the same group who give advice in 2:2. They are with him in the night.

decisions.choice: high rank
decisions.reason: "Greatness" in modern English sounds like a quality of character; Balanced says "high rank", the kind of greatness meant.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִ֣י בֶחָצֵ֑ר וְהָמָ֣ן בָּ֗א לַחֲצַ֤ר בֵּית־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה לֵאמֹ֣ר לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לִתְלוֹת֙ אֶֽת־מָרְדֳּכַ֔י עַל־הָעֵ֖ץ אֲשֶׁר־הֵכִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the king, Who [is] in [the] court? And Haman had come to [the] court of [the] house of the king, the outer, to say to the king to hang Mordecai on the tree that he had prepared for him.

en.L: And the king said, "Who is in the court?" Now Haman had come into the outer court of the king's house to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.
en.B: The king said, "Who is in the court?" Now Haman had just entered the outer court of the palace to ask the king to have Mordecai hanged on the gallows he had set up for him.
en.R: The king asked, "Who is out in the courtyard?" Haman had just come into the outer courtyard of the palace. He had come to ask the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had set up for him.

es.L: Y dijo el rey: «¿Quién [está] en el patio?». Y Amán había venido al patio exterior de la casa del rey para hablar al rey de colgar a Mardoqueo en la horca que le había preparado.
es.B: El rey dijo: «¿Quién está en el patio?». Amán acababa de entrar en el patio exterior del palacio para pedirle al rey que colgaran a Mardoqueo en la horca que le había preparado.
es.R: El rey preguntó: «¿Quién está allá afuera, en el patio?». Amán acababa de llegar al patio exterior del palacio. Había venido a pedirle al rey que colgara a Mardoqueo en la horca que había levantado para él.

fr.L: Et le roi dit : « Qui [est] dans la cour ? » Or Haman était venu dans la cour extérieure de la maison du roi pour dire au roi de pendre Mardochée à la potence qu’il avait préparée pour lui.
fr.B: Le roi dit : « Qui est dans la cour ? » Or Haman venait d’entrer dans la cour extérieure du palais pour demander au roi de faire pendre Mardochée à la potence qu’il avait dressée pour lui.
fr.R: Le roi a demandé : « Qui est là, dans la cour ? » Haman venait d’arriver dans la cour extérieure du palais. Il était venu demander au roi de faire pendre Mardochée à la potence qu’il avait dressée pour lui.

sw.L: Mfalme akasema, "Ni nani [aliye] uani?" Basi Hamani alikuwa ameingia katika ua wa nje wa nyumba ya mfalme, ili kumwambia mfalme amtundike Mordekai juu ya mti wa kunyongea aliokuwa amemwandalia.
sw.B: Mfalme akasema, "Ni nani yuko uani?" Wakati huo Hamani alikuwa ameingia tu katika ua wa nje wa jumba la mfalme, ili kumwomba mfalme amtundike Mordekai juu ya mti wa kunyongea aliokuwa amemsimamishia.
sw.R: Mfalme akauliza, "Ni nani yuko huko nje uani?" Hamani alikuwa amefika tu katika ua wa nje wa jumba la mfalme. Alikuwa amekuja kumwomba mfalme amtundike Mordekai juu ya mti wa kunyongea aliokuwa amemsimamishia.

vi.L: Vua nói: "Ai [ở] trong sân?" Vả, Ha-man đã đến sân ngoài của nhà vua để tâu với vua về việc treo Mạc-đô-chê lên giá treo cổ mà ông ta đã chuẩn bị cho ông ấy.
vi.B: Vua hỏi: "Ai ở ngoài sân?" Lúc ấy Ha-man vừa vào sân ngoài hoàng cung để tâu xin vua cho treo Mạc-đô-chê lên giá treo cổ ông ta đã dựng sẵn cho Mạc-đô-chê.
vi.R: Vua hỏi: "Ai đang ở ngoài sân đó?" Ha-man vừa mới đến sân ngoài của hoàng cung. Ông ta đến để xin vua treo Mạc-đô-chê lên giá treo cổ mà ông ta đã dựng sẵn.

ko.L: 그러자 왕이 말했다. "누가 뜰에 [있느냐]?" 그때 하만은 자기가 모르드개를 위해 준비한 교수대에 모르드개를 매달도록 왕께 말씀드리려고 왕의 집 바깥뜰에 와 있었다.
ko.B: 왕이 말했다. "누가 뜰에 있느냐?" 그때 마침 하만이 자기가 세워 둔 교수대에 모르드개를 매달게 해 달라고 왕께 청하려고 왕궁 바깥뜰에 들어와 있었다.
ko.R: 왕이 물었다. "바깥뜰에 누가 있느냐?" 하만이 막 왕궁 바깥뜰에 들어와 있었다. 그는 모르드개를 위해 세워 둔 교수대에 모르드개를 매달게 해 달라고 왕께 청하러 온 것이었다.

decisions.choice: hang on the tree: put to death and displayed on a tall wooden post
decisions.reason: The word translated "gallows" means "tree" or "wood"; in 5:14 it is a post fifty cubits high. "Hang" may mean hanging by the neck, impaling, or hanging up the body after death; the Persians are known to have impaled people (Ezra 6:11 threatens this). The text does not say which method is meant.

decisions.choice: Haman had come: he arrived at that moment
decisions.reason: The clause breaks into the story to say Haman had just arrived. He has come early, as his wife advised, to ask for Mordecai's death "in the morning" (5:14), at the very moment the king is thinking of how to reward Mordecai.

decisions.choice: the outer court: the courtyard outside the king's inner rooms
decisions.reason: No one could enter the inner court uninvited on pain of death (4:11). Haman waits in the outer court until the king calls him.

decisions.choice: the palace
decisions.reason: "The king's house" means the royal palace; Balanced and Readable say so.

en.B: When Haman came in, the king asked him, "What should be done for the man the king delights to honor?" Haman thought to himself, "Whom would the king delight to honor more than me?"
en.R: When Haman came in, the king asked him, "What should I do for a man I really want to honor?" Haman thought to himself, "Who is there that the king would want to honor more than me?"

es.L: Y entró Amán, y el rey le dijo: «¿Qué se debe hacer al hombre a quien el rey se complace en honrar?». Y dijo Amán en su corazón: «¿A quién se complacería el rey en honrar más que a mí?».

es.R: Cuando Amán entró, el rey le preguntó: «¿Qué debo hacer por un hombre al que de verdad quiero honrar?». Amán pensó: «¿A quién querría honrar el rey más que a mí?».

fr.L: Et Haman entra, et le roi lui dit : « Que faut-il faire pour l’homme que le roi prend plaisir à honorer ? » Et Haman dit en son cœur : « À qui le roi prendrait-il plaisir à faire honneur plus qu’à moi ? »
fr.B: Quand Haman entra, le roi lui demanda : « Que faut-il faire pour l’homme que le roi désire honorer ? » Haman se dit en lui-même : « Qui le roi voudrait-il honorer plus que moi ? »
fr.R: Quand Haman est entré, le roi lui a demandé : « Que dois-je faire pour un homme que je veux vraiment honorer ? » Haman s’est dit : « Qui le roi voudrait-il honorer plus que moi ? »

decisions.choice: the man whom the king delights to honor: the king speaks of himself in the third person and names no one
decisions.reason: Speaking of "the king" instead of "I" is court style. The king does not say whom he means, and Haman, who does not know what was read in the night, assumes it is himself. The phrase is repeated four more times (verses 7, 9 twice, 11) and becomes the refrain of the scene.

decisions.choice: said in his heart: thought to himself
decisions.reason: In Hebrew one "says in the heart" what one thinks without saying it aloud (Genesis 17:17; Psalm 14:1).

decisions.choice: delight: to take pleasure in, to wish
decisions.reason: The verb means to take pleasure in something or someone and so to want it. It is the king's favor, not only a passing wish.

decisions.choice: What should I do for a man I really want to honor?
decisions.reason: Readable lets the king speak in the first person, since English readers may not see that "the king" means the speaker himself.

decisions.choice: the king's own robe and horse: sharing the king's honor in public
decisions.reason: To wear what the king has worn and ride what he has ridden is to be shown to everyone as the king's favorite. Joseph was honored in a similar way by Pharaoh (Genesis 41:42-43), and Solomon was set on David's own mule when he was made king (1 Kings 1:33). Haman asks for honor that comes close to the king's own.

decisions.choice: on its head: the crown is on the horse's head
alternatives: a royal crown placed on the head of the man the king honors
decisions.reason: The pronoun most naturally refers to the horse just mentioned: a royal horse with a crown-like crest on its head, as horses in Persian art sometimes have. It could instead mean that the crown is placed on the head of the honored man, but the crown is not mentioned again in verses 9-11, where the man is dressed and set on the horse.

decisions.choice: crown of royalty: a royal headdress
decisions.reason: This is the word used for the queen's crown (1:11; 2:17). On a horse it means an ornament or crest that marks it as the king's.

decisions.choice: Have servants bring
decisions.reason: Readable says who does the bringing, which the Hebrew leaves open ("let them bring").

es.L: y que se entregue la vestidura y el caballo en mano de uno de los príncipes del rey, de los nobles, y vistan al hombre a quien el rey se complace en honrar, y lo hagan cabalgar sobre el caballo por la plaza de la ciudad, y pregonen delante de él: ‘Así se hace al hombre a quien el rey se complace en honrar’».

Que vistan al hombre a quien el rey se complace en honrar, lo lleven a caballo por la plaza de la ciudad y proclamen delante de él: ‘¡Esto es lo que se hace por el hombre a quien el rey se complace en honrar!’».

Que él le ponga el manto al hombre a quien el rey quiere honrar, y que lo lleve en el caballo por la plaza de la ciudad. Qu’il crie devant lui : “Voilà ce que le roi fait pour l’homme qu’il veut honorer !” »

sw.L: na mavazi hayo na farasi huyo watiwe mkononi mwa mmoja wa wakuu wa mfalme, watu mashuhuri, nao wamvike mtu ambaye mfalme anapendezwa kumheshimu, na wampandishe juu ya farasi katika uwanja wa mji, na watangaze mbele yake, 'Hivi ndivyo anavyofanyiwa mtu ambaye mfalme anapendezwa kumheshimu!'"
sw.B: na mavazi hayo na farasi wakabidhiwe mmoja wa maafisa mashuhuri kabisa wa mfalme. Na wamvike mtu ambaye mfalme anapenda kumheshimu, wamwongoze juu ya farasi katika uwanja wa mji, na kutangaza mbele yake, 'Hivi ndivyo anavyofanyiwa mtu ambaye mfalme anapenda kumheshimu!'"
sw.R: Kisha umkabidhi mmoja wa viongozi muhimu kabisa wa mfalme vazi hilo na farasi huyo. Yeye amvike vazi hilo mtu ambaye mfalme anataka kumheshimu, na kumwongoza juu ya farasi katika uwanja wa mji. Atangaze kwa sauti mbele yake, 'Hivi ndivyo mfalme anavyomfanyia mtu anayetaka kumheshimu!'"

vi.L: và hãy giao áo và ngựa vào tay một trong các quan trưởng của vua, là các nhà quý tộc, và người ta hãy mặc áo cho người mà vua vui lòng tôn trọng, và cho người ấy cưỡi ngựa đi qua quảng trường của thành, và hô lên trước mặt người ấy: 'Người mà vua vui lòng tôn trọng thì được đối đãi như thế này!'"
vi.B: rồi giao bộ vương bào và con ngựa cho một vị quan chức cao quý nhất của bệ hạ. Người ta sẽ mặc áo cho người mà bệ hạ muốn tôn vinh, dắt người ấy cưỡi ngựa đi qua quảng trường trong thành, và tung hô trước mặt người: 'Người mà vua muốn tôn vinh thì được đối đãi như thế này!'"
vi.R: Rồi xin đức vua trao áo và ngựa cho một trong những người lãnh đạo quan trọng nhất của đức vua. Người ấy sẽ mặc áo cho người mà đức vua muốn tôn vinh, rồi dắt ngựa đưa người đi qua quảng trường thành phố. Người ấy sẽ hô lớn phía trước: 'Đây là điều vua làm cho người mà vua muốn tôn vinh!'"

ko.L: 그 옷과 말을 왕의 대신들 가운데 한 사람, 곧 귀족의 손에 넘겨, 왕께서 존귀하게 하기를 기뻐하시는 사람에게 그 옷을 입히고, 그를 말에 태워 성의 광장으로 다니게 하며, 그 앞에서 '왕께서 존귀하게 하기를 기뻐하시는 사람에게는 이렇게 한다!' 하고 외치게 하십시오."
ko.B: 그 옷과 말을 임금님의 가장 귀한 대신들 가운데 한 사람에게 맡겨, 임금님께서 높여 주기를 기뻐하시는 사람에게 옷을 입히고, 말에 태워 성 안 광장으로 이끌고 다니며, 그 앞에서 '왕께서 높여 주기를 기뻐하시는 사람에게는 이렇게 한다!' 하고 외치게 하십시오."
ko.R: 그다음에 그 옷과 말을 임금님의 가장 높은 지도자들 가운데 한 사람에게 맡기십시오. 그 사람이 임금님께서 높여 주고 싶으신 사람에게 옷을 입히고, 그를 말에 태워 성 안 광장으로 이끌고 다니게 하십시오. 그리고 그 앞에서 '왕께서 높여 주고 싶으신 사람에게는 이렇게 해 주신다!' 하고 외치게 하십시오."

decisions.choice: the officials of the king, the nobles: one of the highest nobles
decisions.reason: The second word is a Persian word for the nobility, used for the great men at the king's first feast (1:3). Haman asks that the honored man be served by one of the highest men in the kingdom, never thinking it will be himself.

decisions.choice: a public parade and proclamation in the city square
decisions.reason: The open square near the gate was the city's public place (Nehemiah 8:1). Leading a man through it while a herald calls out made his honor known to everyone, as when Joseph rode in Pharaoh's chariot and people called out before him (Genesis 41:43).

decisions.choice: make him ride: set him on the horse and lead him
decisions.reason: The verb means to cause someone to ride. The noble walks and leads the horse, while the honored man rides.

decisions.choice: lead him on horseback; lead him on the horse
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "make him ride" means in this scene; Literal keeps the causative verb.

decisions.choice: This is what the king does for the man he wants to honor
decisions.reason: Readable names the king as the one who honors, which the passive "it is done" implies.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לְהָמָ֗ן מַ֠הֵר קַ֣ח אֶת־הַלְּב֤וּשׁ וְאֶת־הַסּוּס֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ וַֽעֲשֵׂה־כֵן֙ לְמָרְדֳּכַ֣י הַיְּהוּדִ֔י הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ אַל־תַּפֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֔ר מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the king to Haman, Hurry, take the clothing and the horse as you have spoken, and do so to Mordecai the Jew, the [one] sitting in [the] gate of the king; not let fall a word from all that you have spoken.

en.L: And the king said to Haman, "Hurry, take the clothing and the horse, as you have said, and do so for Mordecai the Jew, who sits in the king's gate. Do not let a word fall from all that you have said."
en.B: Then the king said to Haman, "Hurry! Take the robes and the horse just as you have said, and do this for Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king's gate. Do not leave out anything you have proposed."
en.R: Then the king told Haman, "Hurry! Get the robe and the horse, just as you said, and do all this for Mordecai the Jew, who serves at the king's gate. Do not leave out a single thing you have suggested."

es.L: Y dijo el rey a Amán: «Apresúrate, toma la vestidura y el caballo, como has dicho, y hazlo así con Mardoqueo el judío, que se sienta a la puerta del rey. No dejes caer una palabra de todo lo que has dicho».
es.B: Entonces el rey le dijo a Amán: «¡Date prisa! Toma las vestiduras y el caballo, tal como has dicho, y haz esto con Mardoqueo el judío, que se sienta a la puerta del rey. No omitas nada de lo que has propuesto».
es.R: Entonces el rey le dijo a Amán: «¡Rápido! Trae el manto y el caballo, tal como dijiste, y haz todo eso con Mardoqueo el judío, que sirve a la puerta del rey. No dejes de hacer ni una sola cosa de las que sugeriste».

fr.L: Et le roi dit à Haman : « Hâte-toi, prends le vêtement et le cheval, comme tu l’as dit, et fais ainsi pour Mardochée le Juif, qui est assis à la porte du roi. Ne laisse tomber aucune parole de tout ce que tu as dit. »
fr.B: Alors le roi dit à Haman : « Vite ! Prends les vêtements et le cheval, comme tu l’as dit, et fais cela pour Mardochée le Juif, qui siège à la porte du roi. N’omets rien de tout ce que tu as proposé. »
fr.R: Alors le roi a dit à Haman : « Vite ! Va chercher le vêtement et le cheval, comme tu l’as dit, et fais tout cela pour Mardochée le Juif, qui est en service à la porte du roi. N’oublie pas une seule des choses que tu as proposées. »

sw.L: Mfalme akamwambia Hamani, "Fanya haraka, uchukue mavazi na farasi, kama ulivyosema, ukamfanyie hivyo Mordekai Myahudi, aketiye katika lango la mfalme. Usiache neno lolote lianguke katika yote uliyoyasema."
sw.B: Ndipo mfalme akamwambia Hamani, "Fanya haraka! Chukua mavazi na farasi kama ulivyosema, ukamfanyie hivyo Mordekai Myahudi, anayeketi katika lango la mfalme. Usiache kitu chochote ulichopendekeza."
sw.R: Ndipo mfalme akamwambia Hamani, "Haraka! Lete vazi na farasi, kama ulivyosema, ukamfanyie Mordekai Myahudi mambo hayo yote, yeye anayehudumu kwenye lango la mfalme. Usiache hata jambo moja ulilopendekeza."

vi.L: Vua phán với Ha-man: "Hãy mau lên, lấy áo và ngựa như ngươi đã nói, và làm như vậy cho Mạc-đô-chê, người Do Thái, là người ngồi tại cổng vua. Đừng để rơi một lời nào trong mọi điều ngươi đã nói."
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua phán với Ha-man: "Mau lên! Hãy lấy bộ vương bào và con ngựa như ngươi đã nói, và làm như thế cho Mạc-đô-chê, người Do Thái, là người ngồi nơi cổng hoàng cung. Đừng bỏ sót điều gì ngươi đã đề nghị."
vi.R: Vua bảo Ha-man: "Nhanh lên! Hãy đi lấy áo và ngựa như ngươi đã nói, rồi làm tất cả những điều đó cho Mạc-đô-chê, người Do Thái, là người đang phục vụ tại cổng hoàng cung. Đừng bỏ sót một điều nào ngươi đã đề nghị."

ko.L: 그러자 왕이 하만에게 말했다. "서둘러라. 네가 말한 대로 그 옷과 말을 가져다가, 왕의 문에 앉아 있는 유대인 모르드개에게 그렇게 하여라. 네가 말한 모든 것 가운데 한 마디도 떨어뜨리지 마라."
ko.B: 그러자 왕이 하만에게 말했다. "서둘러라! 네가 말한 대로 옷과 말을 가져다가, 대궐 문에 앉아 있는 유대인 모르드개에게 그대로 하여라. 네가 말한 것 가운데 하나도 빠뜨리지 마라."
ko.R: 그러자 왕이 하만에게 말했다. "어서 가거라! 네가 말한 대로 옷과 말을 가져다가, 대궐 문에서 일하는 유대인 모르드개에게 그대로 다 해 주어라. 네가 말한 것 가운데 하나라도 빠뜨려서는 안 된다."

decisions.choice: sitting in the king's gate: holding a post at the royal gate
decisions.reason: The gate of the palace was where officials of the court did their work. Mordecai has sat there since 2:19-21, and there he refused to bow to Haman (3:2; 5:9, 13).

decisions.choice: not let a word fall: leave nothing undone
decisions.reason: A "word" that "falls" is one that is not carried out (Joshua 21:45; 1 Samuel 3:19). The king tells Haman to do every part of what he proposed.

decisions.choice: Mordecai the Jew: the king knows who Mordecai is
decisions.reason: The king names Mordecai and his people. Haman must now honor the man he came to have put to death, and a Jew, whose people Haman has arranged to destroy (3:6, 13). The text does not say whether the king connects this with the decree he allowed.

decisions.choice: serves at the king's gate
decisions.reason: Readable says "serves" so the reader does not picture Mordecai as idle; "sitting" in the gate means holding office there.

decisions.choice: ngươi (the king to Haman)
decisions.reason: The king speaks down to his minister with ngươi and of himself as ta, as the terms note sets for the king and Haman.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֤ח הָמָן֙ אֶת־הַלְּב֣וּשׁ וְאֶת־הַסּ֔וּס וַיַּלְבֵּ֖שׁ אֶֽת־מָרְדֳּכָ֑י וַיַּרְכִּיבֵ֨הוּ֙ בִּרְח֣וֹב הָעִ֔יר וַיִּקְרָ֣א לְפָנָ֔יו כָּ֚כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֥ץ בִּיקָרֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Haman the clothing and the horse, and he clothed Mordecai, and he made him ride in [the] square of the city, and he called before him, Thus it is done for the man whom the king delights in his honor.

en.L: And Haman took the clothing and the horse, and he clothed Mordecai and made him ride through the square of the city, and he called out before him, "This is how it is done for the man whom the king delights to honor!"
en.B: So Haman took the robes and the horse. He dressed Mordecai, led him on horseback through the city square, and proclaimed before him, "This is what is done for the man the king delights to honor!"
en.R: So Haman got the robe and the horse. He put the robe on Mordecai and led him on the horse through the city square. He shouted out ahead of him, "This is what the king does for the man he wants to honor!"

es.L: Y tomó Amán la vestidura y el caballo, y vistió a Mardoqueo y lo hizo cabalgar por la plaza de la ciudad, y pregonó delante de él: «¡Así se hace al hombre a quien el rey se complace en honrar!».
es.B: Así que Amán tomó las vestiduras y el caballo. Vistió a Mardoqueo, lo llevó a caballo por la plaza de la ciudad y proclamó delante de él: «¡Esto es lo que se hace por el hombre a quien el rey se complace en honrar!».
es.R: Así que Amán trajo el manto y el caballo. Le puso el manto a Mardoqueo y lo llevó en el caballo por la plaza de la ciudad. Iba gritando delante de él: «¡Esto es lo que hace el rey por el hombre a quien quiere honrar!».

fr.L: Et Haman prit le vêtement et le cheval, et il revêtit Mardochée et le fit monter à cheval à travers la place de la ville, et il cria devant lui : « C’est ainsi qu’on fait pour l’homme que le roi prend plaisir à honorer ! »
fr.B: Haman prit donc les vêtements et le cheval. Il habilla Mardochée, le conduisit à cheval à travers la place de la ville et proclama devant lui : « Voilà ce qu’on fait pour l’homme que le roi désire honorer ! »
fr.R: Haman est donc allé chercher le vêtement et le cheval. Il a mis le vêtement à Mardochée et l’a conduit sur le cheval à travers la place de la ville. Il criait devant lui : « Voilà ce que le roi fait pour l’homme qu’il veut honorer ! »

sw.L: Basi Hamani akayachukua mavazi na farasi, akamvika Mordekai, akampandisha farasi katika uwanja wa mji, akatangaza mbele yake, "Hivi ndivyo anavyofanyiwa mtu ambaye mfalme anapendezwa kumheshimu!"
sw.B: Basi Hamani akachukua mavazi na farasi. Akamvika Mordekai, akamwongoza juu ya farasi katika uwanja wa mji, akitangaza mbele yake, "Hivi ndivyo anavyofanyiwa mtu ambaye mfalme anapenda kumheshimu!"
sw.R: Basi Hamani akaleta vazi na farasi. Akamvika Mordekai vazi hilo, akamwongoza juu ya farasi katika uwanja wa mji. Akatangaza kwa sauti mbele yake, "Hivi ndivyo mfalme anavyomfanyia mtu anayetaka kumheshimu!"

vi.L: Ha-man lấy áo và ngựa, mặc áo cho Mạc-đô-chê và cho ông cưỡi ngựa đi qua quảng trường của thành, và hô lên trước mặt ông: "Người mà vua vui lòng tôn trọng thì được đối đãi như thế này!"
vi.B: Vậy Ha-man lấy bộ vương bào và con ngựa. Ông ta mặc áo cho Mạc-đô-chê, dắt ông cưỡi ngựa đi qua quảng trường trong thành, và tung hô trước mặt ông: "Người mà vua muốn tôn vinh thì được đối đãi như thế này!"
vi.R: Vậy Ha-man đi lấy áo và ngựa. Ông ta mặc áo cho Mạc-đô-chê rồi dắt ngựa đưa ông đi qua quảng trường thành phố. Ông ta hô lớn phía trước: "Đây là điều vua làm cho người mà vua muốn tôn vinh!"

ko.L: 그리하여 하만이 그 옷과 말을 가져다가 모르드개에게 옷을 입히고, 그를 말에 태워 성의 광장으로 다니게 하며, 그 앞에서 "왕께서 존귀하게 하기를 기뻐하시는 사람에게는 이렇게 한다!" 하고 외쳤다.
ko.B: 그리하여 하만은 옷과 말을 가져왔다. 그는 모르드개에게 옷을 입히고, 말에 태워 성 안 광장으로 이끌고 다니며, 그 앞에서 "왕께서 높여 주기를 기뻐하시는 사람에게는 이렇게 한다!" 하고 외쳤다.
ko.R: 그래서 하만은 옷과 말을 가져왔다. 그는 모르드개에게 옷을 입히고 말에 태워 성 안 광장으로 이끌고 다녔다. 그리고 그 앞에서 "왕께서 높여 주고 싶으신 사람에게는 이렇게 해 주신다!" 하고 외쳤다.

decisions.choice: Haman himself does it all
decisions.reason: Every verb has Haman as its subject. He proposed that one of the nobles serve the honored man (verse 9), and now he is that noble, calling out his own words about Mordecai.

decisions.choice: led him on horseback; led him on the horse
decisions.reason: As in verse 9, Balanced and Readable say what "made him ride" means.

source.text: וַיָּ֥שָׁב מָרְדֳּכַ֖י אֶל־שַׁ֣עַר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְהָמָן֙ נִדְחַ֣ף אֶל־בֵּית֔וֹ אָבֵ֖ל וַחֲפ֥וּי רֹֽאשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And returned Mordecai to [the] gate of the king, and Haman hurried to his house, mourning and covered of head.

en.L: And Mordecai returned to the king's gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and with his head covered.
en.B: Then Mordecai returned to the king's gate, but Haman hurried home, grieving, with his head covered.
en.R: Afterward Mordecai went back to the king's gate. But Haman rushed home with his head covered, full of grief and shame.

es.L: Y volvió Mardoqueo a la puerta del rey, pero Amán se apresuró a ir a su casa, enlutado y con la cabeza cubierta.
es.B: Después Mardoqueo volvió a la puerta del rey, pero Amán se fue de prisa a su casa, apesadumbrado y con la cabeza cubierta.
es.R: Después Mardoqueo regresó a la puerta del rey. Pero Amán se fue corriendo a su casa con la cabeza cubierta, lleno de tristeza y de vergüenza.

fr.L: Et Mardochée retourna à la porte du roi, mais Haman se hâta vers sa maison, en deuil et la tête couverte.
fr.B: Puis Mardochée retourna à la porte du roi, mais Haman rentra chez lui en hâte, affligé, la tête couverte.
fr.R: Ensuite, Mardochée est retourné à la porte du roi. Mais Haman s’est dépêché de rentrer chez lui, la tête couverte, plein de tristesse et de honte.

sw.L: Mordekai akarudi katika lango la mfalme, lakini Hamani akaharakisha kwenda nyumbani kwake, akiomboleza na kichwa chake kimefunikwa.
sw.B: Kisha Mordekai akarudi kwenye lango la mfalme, lakini Hamani akaharakisha kwenda nyumbani, akiwa na huzuni, kichwa chake kimefunikwa.
sw.R: Baadaye Mordekai alirudi kwenye lango la mfalme. Lakini Hamani alikimbilia nyumbani akiwa amejifunika kichwa, akiwa amejaa huzuni na aibu.

vi.L: Mạc-đô-chê trở về cổng vua, còn Ha-man vội vã về nhà mình, buồn rầu và trùm đầu lại.
vi.B: Sau đó Mạc-đô-chê trở về cổng hoàng cung, còn Ha-man vội vã về nhà, sầu não và trùm đầu.
vi.R: Sau đó Mạc-đô-chê trở lại cổng hoàng cung. Còn Ha-man thì vội vã về nhà, trùm đầu lại, lòng đầy buồn rầu và nhục nhã.

ko.L: 그리고 모르드개는 왕의 문으로 돌아갔으나, 하만은 슬퍼하며 머리를 가리고 서둘러 자기 집으로 갔다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 모르드개는 대궐 문으로 돌아갔으나, 하만은 슬픔에 잠겨 머리를 가린 채 서둘러 집으로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 모르드개는 대궐 문으로 돌아갔다. 그러나 하만은 머리를 가린 채 급히 집으로 갔다. 그는 슬프고 부끄러웠다.

decisions.choice: mourning and with covered head: a sign of grief and shame
decisions.reason: Covering the head was a sign of grief or humiliation (2 Samuel 15:30; Jeremiah 14:3-4). Haman goes home as a mourner on the day he expected to triumph.

decisions.choice: Mordecai returns, Haman hurries: two men going opposite ways
decisions.reason: The verse sets the two side by side. Mordecai goes quietly back to his post at the gate, unchanged by the honor; Haman rushes home. The verb used for Haman means to hurry or be driven on.

decisions.choice: full of grief and shame
decisions.reason: Readable says what the covered head showed, since modern readers may not know the custom.

source.text: וַיְסַפֵּ֨ר הָמָ֜ן לְזֶ֤רֶשׁ אִשְׁתּוֹ֙ וּלְכָל־אֹ֣הֲבָ֔יו אֵ֖ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרָ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֩אמְרוּ֩ל֨וֹ חֲכָמָ֜יו וְזֶ֣רֶשׁ אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ אִ֣ם מִזֶּ֣רַע הַיְּהוּדִ֡ים מָרְדֳּכַ֞י אֲשֶׁר֩ הַחִלּ֨וֹתָ לִנְפֹּ֤ל לְפָנָיו֙ לֹא־תוּכַ֣ל ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־נָפ֥וֹל תִּפּ֖וֹל לְפָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And recounted Haman to Zeresh his wife and to all his friends all that had happened to him. And said to him his wise [men] and Zeresh his wife, If from [the] seed of the Jews [is] Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, not you will prevail against him, but falling you will fall before him.

en.L: And Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and to all his friends all that had happened to him. And his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, "If Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, is from the seed of the Jews, you will not prevail against him, but you will surely fall before him."
en.B: Haman told his wife Zeresh and all his friends everything that had happened to him. His advisers and his wife Zeresh said to him, "If Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, is of Jewish descent, you will not get the better of him. You will certainly fall before him."
en.R: Haman told his wife Zeresh and all his friends everything that had happened to him. His advisers and his wife Zeresh said to him, "You have already started to lose to Mordecai. If he is a Jew, you cannot win against him. You will certainly be ruined by him."

es.L: Y contó Amán a Zeres su mujer y a todos sus amigos todo lo que le había sucedido. Y le dijeron sus sabios y Zeres su mujer: «Si Mardoqueo, delante de quien has comenzado a caer, es de la descendencia de los judíos, no prevalecerás contra él, sino que ciertamente caerás delante de él».
es.B: Amán les contó a su esposa Zeres y a todos sus amigos todo lo que le había sucedido. Sus consejeros y su esposa Zeres le dijeron: «Si Mardoqueo, ante quien has comenzado a caer, es de origen judío, no podrás vencerlo. Ciertamente caerás delante de él».
es.R: Amán les contó a su esposa Zeres y a todos sus amigos todo lo que le había pasado. Sus consejeros y su esposa Zeres le dijeron: «Ya has empezado a perder frente a Mardoqueo. Si él es judío, no podrás ganarle. Él será sin duda tu ruina».

fr.L: Et Haman raconta à Zéresh sa femme et à tous ses amis tout ce qui lui était arrivé. Et ses sages et Zéresh sa femme lui dirent : « Si Mardochée, devant qui tu as commencé à tomber, est de la descendance des Juifs, tu ne l’emporteras pas sur lui, mais tu tomberas certainement devant lui. »
fr.B: Haman raconta à sa femme Zéresh et à tous ses amis tout ce qui lui était arrivé. Ses conseillers et sa femme Zéresh lui dirent : « Si Mardochée, devant qui tu as commencé à tomber, est d’origine juive, tu n’auras pas le dessus sur lui. Tu tomberas sûrement devant lui. »
fr.R: Haman a raconté à sa femme Zéresh et à tous ses amis tout ce qui lui était arrivé. Ses conseillers et sa femme Zéresh lui ont dit : « Tu as déjà commencé à perdre face à Mardochée. S’il est juif, tu ne peux pas gagner contre lui. Il causera sûrement ta perte. »

sw.L: Hamani akamsimulia Zereshi mkewe na rafiki zake wote mambo yote yaliyompata. Wenye hekima wake na Zereshi mkewe wakamwambia, "Ikiwa Mordekai, ambaye umeanza kuanguka mbele yake, ni wa uzao wa Wayahudi, hutamshinda, bali hakika utaanguka mbele yake."
sw.B: Hamani akamweleza mkewe Zereshi na rafiki zake wote kila kitu kilichompata. Washauri wake na mkewe Zereshi wakamwambia, "Ikiwa Mordekai, ambaye umeanza kuanguka mbele yake, ni Myahudi kwa asili, hutamshinda. Hakika utaanguka mbele yake."
sw.R: Hamani akamweleza mkewe Zereshi na rafiki zake wote kila kitu kilichompata. Washauri wake na mkewe Zereshi wakamwambia, "Umekwisha kuanza kushindwa na Mordekai. Ikiwa yeye ni Myahudi, huwezi kumshinda. Hakika atakuangamiza."

vi.L: Ha-man thuật lại cho Xê-rết vợ mình và tất cả bạn hữu mình mọi điều đã xảy đến cho mình. Các nhà thông thái của ông ta và Xê-rết vợ ông nói với ông: "Nếu Mạc-đô-chê, người mà ông đã bắt đầu sa sút trước mặt, thuộc dòng dõi người Do Thái, thì ông sẽ không thắng được người, nhưng chắc chắn ông sẽ sa ngã trước mặt người."
vi.B: Ha-man kể cho Xê-rết vợ mình và tất cả bạn hữu mọi việc đã xảy đến cho mình. Các mưu sĩ và Xê-rết vợ ông nói với ông: "Nếu Mạc-đô-chê, người mà ông đã bắt đầu thất thế trước mặt, là người gốc Do Thái, thì ông sẽ không thắng nổi ông ta. Chắc chắn ông sẽ ngã gục trước mặt ông ta."
vi.R: Ha-man kể cho Xê-rết vợ mình và tất cả bạn bè mọi việc đã xảy ra cho mình. Các mưu sĩ và Xê-rết vợ ông bảo ông: "Ông đã bắt đầu thua Mạc-đô-chê rồi. Nếu ông ta là người Do Thái thì ông không thể thắng được đâu. Chắc chắn ông sẽ bị ông ta làm cho tiêu vong."

ko.L: 그리고 하만이 자기 아내 세레스와 자기 모든 친구들에게 자기에게 일어난 모든 일을 이야기했다. 그러자 그의 지혜자들과 그의 아내 세레스가 그에게 말했다. "당신이 그 앞에서 넘어지기 시작한 모르드개가 유대인의 자손이면, 당신은 그를 이기지 못하고 반드시 그 앞에서 넘어질 거예요."
ko.B: 하만은 아내 세레스와 모든 친구들에게 자기에게 일어난 일을 다 이야기했다. 그의 조언자들과 아내 세레스가 그에게 말했다. "당신이 그 앞에서 넘어지기 시작한 모르드개가 유대인 혈통이라면, 당신은 그를 이길 수 없어요. 틀림없이 그 앞에서 넘어지고 말 거예요."
ko.R: 하만은 아내 세레스와 모든 친구들에게 자기에게 일어난 일을 다 이야기했다. 그의 조언자들과 아내 세레스가 말했다. "당신은 벌써 모르드개에게 지기 시작했어요. 모르드개가 유대인이라면 당신은 그를 이길 수 없어요. 당신은 틀림없이 그 사람 때문에 망하고 말 거예요."

decisions.choice: his friends, then his wise men: the same circle of advisers
decisions.reason: The people Haman calls his friends (as in 5:10, 14) are now called his "wise men", that is, his counselors. The word recalls the king's wise men who advised him in 1:13.

decisions.choice: if Mordecai is of Jewish descent: a condition they treat as known
alternatives: since Mordecai is of Jewish descent
decisions.reason: Haman already knows Mordecai is a Jew (3:4-6), so the "if" does not express doubt; it states the ground of what follows: since he is of that people, Haman cannot win.

decisions.choice: why the Jews cannot be overcome: the speakers give no reason
decisions.reason: Haman's advisers do not say why a man of the Jews cannot be defeated. Some readers hear an echo of the old enmity between Israel and Amalek, which ends in Amalek's defeat (Exodus 17:14-16; 1 Samuel 15), since Haman is called the Agagite (3:1); others see a hint that Israel's God protects his people. The book does not name God, and the text leaves the reason unstated.

decisions.choice: fall ... surely fall: the verb repeated for emphasis
decisions.reason: The verb "fall" is used three times: Haman has begun to fall, and he will surely fall, using a doubled verb that stresses certainty. The fall begun today will be complete.

decisions.choice: his advisers
decisions.reason: "Wise men" here means counselors; Balanced and Readable say "advisers" so it does not sound like praise of their wisdom.

decisions.choice: be ruined by him
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "fall before him", total defeat.

decisions.choice: ông (the advisers and Zeresh together to Haman)
decisions.reason: Zeresh speaks together with Haman's advisers, so the group's word for him is the respectful ông; anh / em is kept for husband and wife speaking alone.

source.text: עוֹדָם֙ מְדַבְּרִ֣ים עִמּ֔וֹ וְסָרִיסֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הִגִּ֑יעוּ וַיַּבְהִ֨לוּ֙ לְהָבִ֣יא אֶת־הָמָ֔ן אֶל־הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָ֥ה אֶסְתֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Still they [were] speaking with him, and [the] eunuchs of the king arrived and hurried to bring Haman to the feast that had made Esther.

en.L: While they were still speaking with him, the eunuchs of the king arrived, and they hurried to bring Haman to the feast that Esther had prepared.
en.B: While they were still talking with him, the king's eunuchs arrived and hurried Haman off to the banquet Esther had prepared.
en.R: While they were still talking, the king's palace officials arrived. They rushed Haman off to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

es.L: Todavía estaban ellos hablando con él cuando llegaron los eunucos del rey, y se apresuraron a llevar a Amán al banquete que Ester había preparado.
es.B: Mientras todavía hablaban con él, llegaron los eunucos del rey y se llevaron de prisa a Amán al banquete que Ester había preparado.
es.R: Mientras todavía estaban hablando, llegaron los funcionarios del palacio. Se llevaron a Amán de prisa al banquete que Ester había preparado.

fr.L: Ils parlaient encore avec lui quand les eunuques du roi arrivèrent, et ils se hâtèrent d’amener Haman au festin qu’Esther avait préparé.
fr.B: Ils parlaient encore avec lui quand les eunuques du roi arrivèrent et emmenèrent Haman en hâte au banquet qu’Esther avait préparé.
fr.R: Ils parlaient encore quand les officiers du palais sont arrivés. Ils ont emmené Haman en vitesse au banquet qu’Esther avait préparé.

sw.L: Walipokuwa wangali wakizungumza naye, matowashi wa mfalme wakafika, wakaharakisha kumleta Hamani kwenye karamu aliyoiandaa Esta.
sw.B: Walipokuwa bado wakizungumza naye, matowashi wa mfalme wakafika, wakamchukua Hamani haraka kwenda kwenye karamu aliyoiandaa Esta.
sw.R: Walipokuwa bado wakizungumza, maafisa wa ikulu wakafika. Wakamchukua Hamani upesi kwenda kwenye karamu aliyoiandaa Esta.

vi.L: Họ còn đang nói với ông thì các hoạn quan của vua đến, và họ vội vàng đưa Ha-man đến dự tiệc mà Ê-xơ-tê đã dọn.
vi.B: Khi họ còn đang nói chuyện với ông, các hoạn quan của vua đến và vội đưa Ha-man đi dự yến tiệc Ê-xơ-tê đã dọn.
vi.R: Họ còn đang nói thì các quan chức trong cung đến. Họ vội đưa Ha-man đi dự bữa tiệc mà Ê-xơ-tê đã chuẩn bị.

ko.L: 그들이 아직 그와 말하고 있을 때에 왕의 내시들이 이르러, 에스더가 차린 잔치에 하만을 데려가려고 서둘렀다.
ko.B: 그들이 아직 하만과 이야기하고 있을 때 왕의 내시들이 와서, 에스더가 베푼 잔치에 하만을 서둘러 데려갔다.
ko.R: 그들이 아직 이야기하고 있을 때 궁중 관리들이 왔다. 그들은 에스더가 준비한 잔치에 하만을 서둘러 데려갔다.

decisions.choice: the eunuchs come to escort Haman to the banquet
decisions.reason: Haman had already been invited to Esther's second banquet (5:8, 12). Guests of the court were escorted by royal servants. Their haste leaves him no time to recover.

decisions.choice: feast: a banquet of wine
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "to drink" and names a banquet where wine was served (5:6; 7:2, 7).

decisions.choice: palace officials
decisions.reason: Readable says "palace officials" for the eunuchs, as elsewhere in Esther (see 1:10).
